primary_question: Can the validated point-in-time own-trend plus relative-strength entry rank be converted into a lower-turnover portfolio by retaining incumbents until economic eligibility fails, without adding a new threshold or calendar parameter?

frozen_data.source: Binance public historical ordinary spot-USDT pairs, including later inactive, BREAK and missing-current-status symbols

only_authorized_change.description: Daily Top-2 membership selects entries only. An incumbent remains selected while its existing own-trend, relative-trend, continuous-history and completed-day liquidity eligibility all remain valid.
only_authorized_change.replacement_rule: When risk-on and fewer than two eligible incumbents remain, fill vacancies with the highest current validated entry rank among eligible non-incumbents.

frozen_portfolio.selected_alt_weighting: unchanged current positive rank-score proportional weighting subject to cap; capped excess returns to BTC
frozen_portfolio.mandatory_rebalance: selected-name set changes or BTC risk-on/risk-off transition
frozen_portfolio.signal_execution: completed t information held over t+1

registered_comparisons: 100 fixed-random-priority placebo portfolios using the same eligibility-exit state machine
required_outputs: turnover decomposition into BTC, alt-sleeve-size and within-alt name switching
right-tail winner capture and contribution concentration
placebo percentile under the same state machine
comparison with rejected PIT-ALPHA-0016 and canonical benchmarks

requirements: materially longer holding duration than the 1-day median in AUDIT-0017
retain the validated rank advantage versus same-state-machine placebos
improve drawdown and cost robustness relative to PIT-ALPHA-0016
not remain economically negative from 2025 onward
not depend on one ex-post winner

prohibited: no weekly or monthly rebalance calendar
no Top-N family selection from PNL
no hard-coded ETH, SOL, BNB, HYPE or other preferred universe
no funding, dispersion, covariance, LPM, volatility gate or leverage overlay
no post-result parameter change under this experiment ID
